metadata.purpose: Live baseline evidence run 2026-07-21: Qwen 3 Coder 30B A3B, port 48127, direct llama-server

issue253Comparability.note: For #253 pairing with qwen36-35b-live.json (maxTokens=4096, baseUrl 8080), baseUrl was moved from the standalone direct llama-server on port 48127 to the shared router on port 8080 (which also serves openai/qwen3.6-35b-a3b per models-preset.ini and llama-qwen36.service), and maxTokens was raised from 512 to 4096 so neither model is disadvantaged by a smaller output budget. Both changes hold server configuration and output budget constant across the two audited models so any parse-rate difference is attributable to the model, not the harness.

metadata.noThinkIsIntentionalAsymmetry: No noThink field is set: qwen3-coder-30b is a non-reasoning model and has no think block to bound. This mirrors the presence of noThink=true on qwen36-35b-live.json, which IS a reasoning model. This asymmetry is intentional and model-intrinsic, not an uncontrolled variable.
